shortlist.requirement: The unloaded state is an energy minimum with a finite, positive physical tangent response.
Native reversible stress is generated from a state functional/action so loading stores energy and unloading returns it consistently.
Perturbations possess a well-posed causal propagation sector compatible with the PBUF signal and effective-GR requirements.

shortlist.property: Linear tangent and nonlinear finite-response completion
shortlist.requirement: The law reduces to linear elasticity near equilibrium but remains defined and stable over the admitted finite-deformation domain.
The physical branch respects the finite elastic bound and approaches saturation or another regular limiting endpoint without singular or negative-energy continuation.
Tangent response and homogeneous stored energy inherit the already-authoritative PBUF thermal and cosmological state dependence without redefining it.
The eventual kinematics and metric map can respond to the full stress-energy load and support the shear/tensor sector needed by the effective-GR limit.
The future theory must declare and derive whether its constitutive operator is local, gradient-enriched, or genuinely causal-nonlocal, distinguishing this from a nonlocal Green-function solution.
